hypotheses.subject: legacy-checkout-fallback
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag legacy-checkout-fallback was toggled from on to off at 2026-09-01T23:20:00Z. With the fallback disabled, the account-page code path hit an unguarded ZeroDivisionError, driving the error rate from ~1% baseline to ~26-34% for every minute after the flip.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-01T23:20:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
2026-09-01T23:20:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 34% over the last minute
Every recorded change to kukibuki-service from 2026-08-31T23:20:00Z to 2026-09-01T23:20:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternatively, a code change already deployed earlier contained the divide-by-zero defect, which was merely unmasked when the flag flipped; the flag toggle would then be the trigger rather than the root defect. No deploy is recorded in the 24h lookback or around the onset, so this is unsupported by the change channel.
supporting_evidence: Every recorded change to kukibuki-service from 2026-08-31T23:20:00Z to 2026-09-01T23:20:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)
2026-09-01T23:20:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

hypotheses.summary: Pre-onset UpstreamTimeout errors on payment authorization were present but at ~0-2% and stopped at the flip; they do not account for the sustained 26-34% error rate, so an upstream dependency failure is not the cause here.
